values.value: Families receive notices for invoices, payments, reminders, waitlist offers, refunds, cancelled sessions, report cards, re-enrolment invitations and library reminders, by email and in the portal. Email delivery is currently {{Setting:Email_Delivery}} (Off means emails are logged as not sent; portal messages are still delivered). A guardian or learner who opted out of email still receives portal messages. Payment reminders are sent {{Setting:Due_Soon_Days}} days before the due date and on days {{Setting:Overdue_Reminder_Days}} after it.
